examples.text: 2023 and 2024 were consecutive global average temperature records.
Ukraine and Russia signed a ceasefire this month.
Unemployment in France has doubled since 2020.
Brazil's Law 12.965/2014 requires providers to keep logs for 5 years.

gemini: Sign in with your Google account at aistudio.google.com/apikey
Click “Create API key” and copy it
groq: Create a free account at console.groq.com
Under “API Keys”, create and copy a key
ollama: Install Ollama (ollama.com) and run: ollama pull llama3.1

strings.meta_description: Check news and messages against official sources, for free.
strings.ask_title: What do you want to check?
strings.ask_lead: Paste the message, headline or sentence you received. We search the official sources.
strings.claim_placeholder: Paste the text here, or paste a screenshot (Ctrl+V)… E.g.: “Vaccines cause autism in children.”
strings.drop_hint: Drop the image to read its text
strings.upload_hint: We examine the media: metadata, AI signals and what is said.
strings.ocr_reading: Reading the text in the image…
strings.ocr_first_time: The first time may take a few seconds.
strings.ocr_none: We found no text in this image.
strings.ocr_none_hint: Try a sharper photo or type the text.
strings.ocr_done_hint: Check the text above and fix it if needed.
strings.ocr_fail_hint: Check your connection or type the text.
strings.source_label: Where did this information come from?
strings.source_placeholder: Link to the article, post or video
strings.source_hint: With the link, we check whether the page was changed or deleted. Video links (YouTube, TikTok, X, Instagram) are downloaded and examined.
strings.ai_summary_sub: Optional and free · no credit card
strings.ai_intro: Without AI you already get the official sources. With AI, you also get an explained verdict.
strings.remember_label: Remember on this device (don't ask again after reloading)
strings.clear_ai: Back to free mode without AI
strings.privacy_session: Your key stays only in this tab and disappears when you close it. The Veritas server only uses it during each check and never stores it.
strings.privacy_saved: Your key is stored only in this browser. Untick the option to erase it from here. The Veritas server never stores it.
strings.empty_lead: We query official databases in real time, for free:
strings.how_3: the answer with whoever needs it
strings.media_loading_5: Checking the claims against official sources…
strings.cta_text: Turn on a free AI in 1 minute.
strings.no_sources: No official source addressed this. Try describing the claim in other words.
strings.error_title: We couldn't check this right now
strings.footer_text: Veritas Engine · open source · data from official public sources
strings.cert_strong_true: High confidence: official sources confirm it ({pct}%).
strings.cert_weak: Low confidence ({pct}%): read the sources before drawing a conclusion.
strings.cert_neutral: Neither true nor false: the sources found don't settle it. There is no truth percentage in this case.
strings.v_misleading_meaning: Partly true, but out of context or exaggerated.
strings.v_inconclusive_meaning: The sources found don't allow a safe conclusion.
strings.v_no_data_meaning: We found no official data on this subject.
strings.v_no_data_meaning_sources: The official sources found don't directly address this claim.
strings.v_raw_meaning: We gathered what the official sources say. Read them and draw your own conclusion.
strings.c2pa_ai_generated: The content credentials state that the media was generated by AI ({tool}).
strings.c2pa_ai_edited: The credentials state that the media was edited with AI ({tool}).
strings.c2pa_camera: The credentials indicate an original camera capture, with no recorded edits.
strings.c2pa_signed_unknown: The media has content credentials, but does not state how it was created.
strings.c2pa_invalid: The content signature does not match: the media was altered after being signed.
strings.c2pa_no_manifest: No content credentials (C2PA). Most photos and videos have none, and social networks usually strip them: this proves neither that the media is fake nor that it is real.
strings.c2pa_untrusted: The certificate is not on the C2PA trust list: confirm the origin.
strings.how_get_free_key: How to get your free key:
strings.key_masked: This key is masked (it has * or …). That's the short version shown in the dashboard list. On {name}, the full key is shown only once, when it is created: create a new key at {console} and copy it right away.
strings.key_prefix: {name} keys start with “{prefix}”. Check that you copied the key (not its name) and picked the right provider above.
strings.key_short: The key looks incomplete: it has {length} characters, and {name} keys usually have {typical}. Copy the whole key again.
strings.ai_tip_console: Tip: on {name}, the full key is shown only once, when it is created. If you copied it from the key list, create a new one at {console} and copy it right away.
strings.ai_tip_generic: Check that you copied the whole key and picked the right provider.
strings.ai_quota: The free quota has run out for now. Wait a few minutes or use another free provider.{said}
strings.ai_model_missing: The AI model is not available for this key.{said}
strings.ai_timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Try again.
strings.ai_connect: Could not reach the AI provider. Check your internet connection.
strings.ai_malformed: The key has invalid characters. Copy it again, just the key.
strings.ai_paste_key: Paste your key in the field above.
strings.ai_testing: Testing the connection to the AI…
strings.ai_no_server: No connection to the Veritas server.
strings.media_wrong_type: Upload a photo, a video or an audio file.
strings.media_too_big: File too large ({size}). The limit is 50 MB.
strings.media_video_hint: We'll examine the video and check what is said in it. Add context above if you like.
strings.media_audio_hint: We'll transcribe the audio and check what is said. Add context above if you like.
strings.need_claim: Write or paste the claim you want to check.
strings.media_timeout: The media analysis took too long. Try a smaller file or a shorter clip.
strings.sources_timeout: The sources took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
strings.no_browser_translate: Your browser can't translate on its own.
strings.media_m_true_one: The checked claim matches the official sources.
strings.media_m_true_many: All {count} checked claims match the official sources.
strings.media_m_worst_many: At least one of the {count} checked claims was rated “{label}”.
strings.media_done_checks: We gathered the media forensics and the official sources for the claims found.
strings.media_done_none: See below what the forensics found in the media.
strings.not_transcribed: The speech was not transcribed (see the notice above).
strings.alert_ai_title: The AI didn't answer, so we're showing only the official data.
strings.connector_failed: The {area} source ({id}) did not answer in time.
strings.share_footer: Checked with Veritas · check before you share
strings.card_checked_on: Checked on {day} · data from official public sources
strings.card_no_claim: There is no checked claim to make the card.
strings.note_free_keys: To get an AI-explained verdict without paying anything: create a free Google Gemini key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey or a Groq key at https://console.groq.com/keys (no credit card), or use a local model with Ollama.
strings.note_vague: The claim doesn't say where, when or who: so no source can confirm or deny it. Add the city or country, the approximate date or who is involved and check again.
strings.note_ai_unavailable: AI unavailable ({reason}). Showing the raw official data.
strings.note_downgraded: Verdict {from} downgraded to {to}: no retrieved official source was cited as a basis.
strings.note_triage_failed: AI triage failed; heuristic country/term detection was used.
strings.note_no_transcript: No transcription: to transcribe audio for free, turn on a free Groq or Gemini key in the app, or install offline Whisper with .\run.ps1 -Whisper.
strings.note_no_claims: No checkable claim was found in the speech.
strings.warn_unknown_type: Unrecognised file type: only the fingerprint was computed.
strings.warn_truncated: Media lasts {seconds} s: only the first {max} s were analysed.
strings.warn_no_audio: The media has no audio track.
strings.warn_no_exif: No capture date or camera: common in screenshots and in images forwarded by apps (which strip metadata). It doesn't prove editing, but reduces traceability.
strings.missing_ffmpeg: ffmpeg: duration, audio and keyframes (install full forensics: .\run.ps1 -Full)
strings.missing_c2pa: c2pa: detection of AI-generated images (install full forensics: .\run.ps1 -Full)
strings.note_no_key: No AI key provided: citizen mode on.
strings.err_need_media: Upload a file or paste the link to the video, audio or image.
strings.err_internal_link: This link points to an internal network and cannot be opened.
strings.err_link_scheme: The link must start with http:// or https://.
strings.err_redirects: The link redirects too many times.
strings.err_moved: The link changed address during the download.
strings.err_too_big: The file is over the size limit.
strings.err_video_limit: The video is over the duration or size limit.
strings.err_needs_ytdlp: Downloading videos from links requires yt-dlp (pip install yt-dlp).
